title: Owner Courtesy on Estimate Overage Credits — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account at Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum, an owner courtesy is added to an estimate overage credit according to how the vehicle on the line's labor charge was bought from the group, as the customer's Vehicle Purchase Agreements records show.

| Vehicle on the line's labor charge | Account tier | Added to an overage credit |
|---|---|---|
| Has a closed purchase deal financed on a dealer-arranged installment contract | Gold or Platinum | 25.00 |
| Has a closed purchase deal paid in cash or through an outside lender | Gold or Platinum | 15.00 |
| Any other case, including another tier, no closed purchase deal for that vehicle, or a closed deal on other terms | — | Nothing |

**Terms.** The vehicle is the one recorded on the labor charge of the concern line reviewed. A purchase deal counts only once its status is closed; the way it was paid is the financing recorded on that deal.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- Gold account; the line's vehicle was bought on a closed deal assigned to a lender by the store: 25.00 is added.
- Platinum account; the vehicle was bought for cash on a closed deal: 15.00 is added.
- Silver account; the vehicle was bought on a closed installment deal: nothing is added.
